# Public contract digest

_Every published command, tool, result shape, configuration key, and convention, rendered from the committed contract artifacts._

Each section renders one publication from its artifact under `schema/`: the surface's contract sentence, its same-major policy, and a table for every member. Evolving members carry their tier, open vocabularies list their known members, and closed vocabularies list the members each artifact carries.

The digest is a reading aid. The artifacts are the contract, and the [compatibility policy](../70-reference/compatibility-policy.md) explains the rules the comparators enforce.

## A. CLI grammar manifest (`schema/discern-cli.json`, policy `cli-append-only`)

Command paths, aliases, positional arguments, flags, option value counts and types, defaults, and visibility; listing order is not promised.

Same-major releases may update help, add commands, aliases, and options, add accepted values, and append optional positional arguments. Existing grammar stays. Listing order is not promised. Commands marked evolving may change in any release.

Implicit flags: root `-V`, `--version`; every command `-h`, `--help`.

### Arguments by command

**`discern setup begin`**

| Argument          | Value             | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------- | ----------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`          | `<name:string>`   |         | Project name (free text).                                                                                                                                   |
| `--slug`          | `<slug:string>`   |         | Project slug (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$).                                                                                                                        |
| `--branch-prefix` | `<prefix:string>` |         | Branch prefix for worktrees.                                                                                                                                |
| `--brief`         | `<brief:string>`  |         | Free-text project description, or @path to read it from a file.                                                                                             |
| `--agents`        | `<agents:string>` |         | Comma-separated agent files to emit: claude_code, codex, gemini, cursor, copilot.                                                                           |
| `--map`           | `<path:string>`   |         | Project-relative directory for the project map — discern's agent-maintained documentation tree.                                                             |
| `--config`        | `<file:string>`   |         | JSON answers file (or - for stdin) to scaffold declaratively.                                                                                               |
| `--model`         | `<model:string>`  |         | Your self-declared provider/model identifier, or `unreported`; advisory self-reported setup provenance.                                                     |
| `--dry-run`       | boolean           |         | Print the plan and write nothing.                                                                                                                           |
| `--reseed`        | boolean           |         | Run setup again and refresh discern's files and settings.                                                                                                   |
| `--allow-dirty`   | boolean           |         | Advanced/CI: set up on the current branch as-is, skipping the clean-tree check and the isolated discern-setup branch.                                       |
| `--confirmed`     | boolean           |         | Attest you have held the setup consent conversation with your human — required for a fresh, non-declarative begin; its absence re-serves that conversation. |

## B. MCP tools manifest (`schema/discern-mcp-tools.json`, policy `mcp-tools-append-only`)

Tool names, request schemas, and safety annotations, plus every resource name, kind, and URI; listing order and descriptive text are not promised.

Same-major releases may update documentation, add tools, resources, and optional inputs, and add accepted input values. Existing identities, URIs, safety annotations, and requests stay compatible. Listing order is not promised. Tools marked evolving may change in any release.

| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `discern_status`                 | Orient in the project               | `readOnly`, `idempotent` | `all:boolean`, `local:boolean`, `verbose:boolean`, `path:string`                                                                                                                                            |
| `discern_start`                  | Start a worktree                    |                          | `name:string`, `title:string`, `brief:string`, `from:string`, `path:string`, `dry_run:boolean`                                                                                                              |
| `discern_prepare`                | Run the fast gate                   |                          | `path:string`                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `discern_done`                   | Run the final gate and record Proof |                          | `dry_run:boolean`, `ci:boolean`, `rerun:boolean`, `met:string[]`, `unmet:object`, `path:string`, `policy_base:string`, `standalone:boolean`                                                                 |
| `discern_update`                 | Update this branch                  | `idempotent`             | `from:string`, `dry_run:boolean`, `path:string`                                                                                                                                                             |
| `discern_await`                  | Await a fleet condition             | `readOnly`, `idempotent` | `green:string`, `landed:string`, `trunk_moved:boolean`, `resume:string`, `timeout:number`, `path:string`                                                                                                    |
| `discern_accept`                 | Accept or queue the worktree        | `destructive`            | `target:string`, `action:enum`, `reason:string`, `prepare:boolean`, `preparation_receipt:string`, `met:string[]`, `unmet:object`, `composition_receipt:string`, `approval_token:string`, `recover:string`,… |

| `discern_progress`               | Read a long operation back          | `readOnly`, `idempotent` | `handle:string`, `path:string`                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `discern_test`                   | Run the standalone test stage       |                          | `path:string`                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `discern_standards`              | Measure or propose standard limits  |                          | `action*:enum`, `dry_run:boolean`, `force:boolean`, `pin:boolean`, `names:string[]`, `proposals:object[]`, `path:string`                                                                                    |

### Resources and resource templates

A `template` URI carries a placeholder the client fills in; a `resource` URI is read as written. Names are written plain: a hyphenated `discern-` name in a code span reads as a skill citation to the map preflight.

| Resource           | Kind     | URI                        |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------------------------- |
| discern-status     | resource | `discern://status`         |
| discern-impact     | resource | `discern://impact`         |
| discern-config     | resource | `discern://config`         |
| discern-map-index  | resource | `discern://map`            |
| discern-map-doc    | template | `discern://map/{+target}`  |
| discern-docs-index | resource | `discern://docs`           |
| discern-docs-doc   | template | `discern://docs/{+target}` |

## C. Result contracts (`schema/discern-results.schema.json`, policy `result-output`)

Every CLI `--json` and MCP tool result envelope, with open vocabularies published as strings, closed vocabularies enumerated, and evolving contracts marked.

Same-major releases may add optional fields, new contracts, and members of any open vocabulary. A closed decision vocabulary changes only with a new major. Members marked evolving may change in any release.

### Envelope fields shared by every result

| Field                 | Type              | Notes                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ok` **(req)**        | `boolean`         |                                                                                                                                                |
| `dry_run`             | `boolean`         |                                                                                                                                                |
| `plan`                | `object`          | fields: `title`, `details`, `steps`                                                                                                            |
| `steps`               | `object[]`        | items: `kind`, `label`, `disposition`, `note`, `group`, `outcome`, `advisory`, `duration_s`, `output_path`, `output_lines`, `error_like_lines` |
| `waited_ms`           | `number`          |                                                                                                                                                |
| `diagnostics`         | `object[]`        | items: `tool`, `severity`, `message`, `reproduce_cmd`, `output`, `truncated`, `output_path`, `file`, `line`, `col`, `rule`, `fix_available`    |
| `diagnostic_evidence` | `object`          | fields: `path`, `digest`, `bytes`, `total`, `shown`, `repeats`                                                                                 |
| `hints`               | `string[]`        |                                                                                                                                                |
| `advisories`          | `object[]`        | items: `kind`, `evidence`, `next_action`                                                                                                       |
| `error`               | `string`          |                                                                                                                                                |
| `message`             | `string`          |                                                                                                                                                |
| `verb` **(req)**      | `const "discern"` |                                                                                                                                                |
| `data`                | `object`          | fields: `issues`                                                                                                                               |

### Completion policies

A completion policy is the semantic authority for when `ok: true` is allowed: which conditions must hold, which degradations may ride as advisories, and how refusal, cancellation, partial effect, and no-op are reported.

## D. `discern.toml` configuration (`schema/discern-config.schema.json`, policy `config-input`)

Every section, key, and value type the engine validates, with evolving sections marked.

Same-major releases may add optional keys, sections, and enum members. Existing keys, types, and defaults stay. Sections marked evolving may change in any release.

| Section                 | Required | Kind     | Description                                                      |
| ----------------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[project]`             |          | `object` | The project's identity and the paths discern keeps for it.       |
| `[repository]`          |          | `object` | Policy every checkout of this repository shares.                 |
| `[map]`                 |          | `object` | Where the project map lives.                                     |
| `[instructions]`        |          | `object` | The instruction sources discern compiles into each agent's file. |
| `[skills]`              |          | `object` | Where your authored skills live, and which skills to leave out.  |
| `[jobs]`                |          | `allOf`  | The commands the gate runs, in one namespace.                    |
| `[setup]`               |          | `object` | Known jobs that do not apply to this project.                    |
| `[scopes]`              |          | `table`  | Named regions of the repository.                                 |
| `[generated]`           |          | `table`  | Committed artifacts that one generator owns.                     |
| `[acceptance]`          |          | `object` | Standing grants for landing without a conversation.              |
| `[worktree]`            |          | `object` | The isolated-worktree workflow.                                  |
| `[standards]`           |          | `table`  | Quality numbers that can never get worse.                        |
| `[checkpoints]`         |          | `table`  | Change-triggered review rules.                                   |
| `[gate]`                |          | `object` | How `discern done` runs its parallel stages.                     |
| `[coupling]` (evolving) |          | `object` | Co-change detection from git history.                            |
| `[scripts]`             |          | `object` | Where your executable project scripts live.                      |
| `[meta]`                | yes      | `object` | Project setup and adoption evidence.                             |

## E. Setup config document (`schema/discern-setup-config.schema.json`, policy `config-input`)

The bounded setup recipe consumed only by `setup begin --config`.

Same-major releases may add optional keys, sections, and enum members. Existing keys, types, and defaults stay. Sections marked evolving may change in any release.

| Section           | Required | Kind               | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------- | -------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[$schema]`       |          | `string`           | Editor-only pointer to this schema; ignored by discern.                                                                                              |
| `[version]`       |          | `string or number` | Document major version. Omit (assumed current) or use a matching major; this build understands version 1.                                            |
| `[name]`          |          | `string`           | Project name (free text).                                                                                                                            |
| `[slug]`          |          | `string`           | Project slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.                                                                 |
| `[branch_prefix]` |          | `string`           | Branch prefix for worktrees, e.g. "agent/".                                                                                                          |
| `[brief]`         |          | `string`           | Free-text description of what the project is.                                                                                                        |
| `[agents]`        |          | `enum[]`           | Which agent integrations to enable: claude_code -> CLAUDE.md, gemini -> GEMINI.md, codex / cursor / copilot -> AGENTS.md.                            |
| `[map]`           |          | `object`           | [map] settings — chiefly the project-relative directory holding discern's agent documentation tree.                                                  |
| `[jobs]`          |          | `allOf`            | [jobs] fills. Known names take a command, list, or { run, timeout } and derive their stage; a custom [jobs.<name>] table requires `stage` and `run`. |
| `[scopes]`        |          | `table`            | [scopes.<name>] tables — a named region defined by `paths`, with optional attributes.                                                                |
| `[generated]`     |          | `table`            | [generated.<name>] tables — committed artifacts, their deterministic regeneration command, and an optional timeout.                                  |
| `[standards]`     |          | `table`            | [standards.<name>] tables. Coverage is just a conventional name.                                                                                     |
| `[checkpoints]`   |          | `table`            | [checkpoints.<name>] tables — change-triggered review rules: trigger fields, mode, and the question the agent judges.                                |
| `[setup]`         |          | `object`           | Bounded [setup] configuration for setup coverage accounting.                                                                                         |
| `[worktree]`      |          | `object`           | Bounded [worktree] configuration for isolated-checkout behavior and resources.                                                                       |

## F. Conventions manifest (`schema/discern-conventions.json`, policy `conventions-append-only`)

Frozen environment, skill, Git, checkpoint, identity, provider, hook, and format conventions; private format revisions are independent.

Same-major releases may add names; published existing values are immutable. Private format versions are not published here.

### Environment variables

| Variable                                  | Group                 | Visibility | Meaning                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `DISCERN_REPO`                            | installation          | public     | GitHub release repository the installer downloads from. Defaults to `jackwh/discern`.                                          |
| `DISCERN_VERSION`                         | installation          | public     | Release version the installer downloads, with or without a leading `v`. Defaults to `latest`.                                  |
| `DISCERN_BIN_DIR`                         | installation          | public     | Install directory. Overrides the installer's automatic destination selection.                                                  |
| `DISCERN_TRUNK`                           | runtime-overrides     | public     | Overrides `[repository].trunk` for the current process. Project Scripts receive the resolved trunk in the same variable.       |
| `DISCERN_NO_ATTRIBUTION`                  | runtime-overrides     | public     | Uses source-only generated-file markers and omits the discern co-author trailer from commits discern composes when set to a…   |
| `DISCERN_PROJECT_SLUG`                    | worktree-identity     | public     | Overrides `[project].slug` when discern derives worktree identities.                                                           |
| `DISCERN_WORKTREE_BRANCH_PREFIX`          | worktree-identity     | public     | Overrides `[repository].branch_prefix` when discern derives worktree branch names.                                             |
| `DISCERN_WORKTREE_ID`                     | worktree-identity     | public     | Sets an explicit worktree id in the process or a configured env file. Accepts letters, numbers, dots, dashes, and underscores. |
| `DISCERN_ROOT`                            | project-scripts       | public     | Absolute project root exported to a Project Script.                                                                            |
| `DISCERN_TOML`                            | project-scripts       | public     | Absolute path to the active `discern.toml` exported to a Project Script.                                                       |
| `DISCERN_SCRIPTS_DIR`                     | project-scripts       | public     | Absolute configured Project Scripts directory exported to a Project Script.                                                    |
| `DISCERN_CHECKPOINT_INPUT`                | checkpoint-commands   | public     | Absolute path to the versioned JSON facts without raw file content for the current checkpoint `when` command. See the…         |
| `DISCERN_WORKTREE_PORT`                   | worktree-environment  | public     | Deterministic development port written to a configured worktree env file when `[worktree].export_port = true`.                 |
| `DISCERN_WORKTREE`                        | worktree-environment  | public     | Generic worktree handle supplied to resource commands and written to configured env files when resources are declared.         |
| `DISCERN_RESOURCE_<NAME>`                 | worktree-environment  | public     | Stable handle for one declared resource. `<NAME>` is the resource name uppercased with non-alphanumeric runs replaced by…      |
| `DISCERN_EXPERIMENTAL_MCP_PRELOAD`        | experimental-features | public     | Requests eager discern MCP loading in supported provider integrations when set to `1`.                                         |
| `DISCERN_EXPERIMENTAL_AWAIT_CALL_SECONDS` | experimental-features | public     | Sets a positive whole-number cap for one experimental automatic await call.                                                    |

| ------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `claude_code` | `CLAUDE.md`      | `.claude/skills` | `.mcp.json`             | `.claude/settings.json`      | SessionStart→session-start, WorktreeCreate→worktree-create, WorktreeRemove→worktree-remove | local: .claude/settings.local.json                                                    |

## G. Landing Proof note (`schema/discern-proof-note.schema.json`, policy `result-output`)

The Proof envelope acceptance attaches to a landed commit, using the Dead Simple Signing Envelope (DSSE) field and payload boundary.

Same-major releases may add optional fields, new contracts, and members of any open vocabulary. A closed decision vocabulary changes only with a new major. Members marked evolving may change in any release.

| `payload` **(req)**     | `string`                                                                                             |         |      | Standard or URL-safe Base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON matching DiscernProofNotePayload, with or without padding. These decoded bytes are the DSSE… |

## I. CLI exit statuses (registry `src/shared/exit_codes.ts`; documented in the manual, not in a schema artifact)

| Status              | Contract                                                                                                                |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `0`                 | The command completed successfully. A bare predicate exits `0` when true.                                               |
| `1`                 | A controlled failure or refusal, a false bare predicate, or an unmet enforcement threshold.                             |
| `2`                 | The command grammar or arguments were invalid, including a bare quiet-result invocation.                                |
| `70`                | discern crashed on an unexpected internal error.                                                                        |
| `124`               | `discern await` reached its call budget before the watched condition held; its result includes the continuation handle. |
| `127`               | A child executable selected by an exec-style boundary could not be started.                                             |
| `129`               | An interrupted run preserved the conventional status derived from SIGHUP.                                               |
| `130`               | An interrupted run preserved the conventional status derived from SIGINT.                                               |
| `143`               | An interrupted run preserved the conventional status derived from SIGTERM.                                              |
| Child status        | `discern queue -- <command>` and `discern scripts <name>` preserve a started child's own exit status.                   |
| Other signal status | A platform-reported child signal preserves its conventional signal status when available.                               |
